panels.description: Online Brokers, deduplicated across placement-driver scrape targets.

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (max by (cluster, broker) (taskite_pd_broker_status{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",status="ONLINE"}))

panels.title: Online Brokers

panels.description: Healthy partitions reported by the current placement-driver Leader. Recovered voters remain active while processing a transient backlog.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (min by (cluster, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_health{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",partition=~"$partition"} and on(pd_node) (taskite_pd_raft_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node"} == 3)))

panels.title: Healthy Partitions

panels.description: Managed Broker clusters whose configured partitions are all healthy according to the current placement-driver Leader.

targets.expr: min by (cluster) (taskite_pd_broker_cluster_health{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster"} and on(pd_node) (taskite_pd_raft_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node"} == 3))

panels.title: Healthy Broker Clusters

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (taskite_pending_incidents{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

panels.description: Current Broker role for each partition

targets.expr: max by (cluster, partition, broker) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"})

panels.title: Current Partition Leader

panels.description: Partition health reported by the current placement-driver Leader: one Leader and an active voter quorum at the same term. Transient processing backlog does not make a recovered voter unhealthy.

targets.expr: min by (cluster, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_health{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",partition=~"$partition"} and on(pd_node) (taskite_pd_raft_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node"} == 3))

panels.title: Partition Health

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(taskite_stream_processor_records_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",action="processed"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

panels.title: Processed Records / s
panels.description: Processed record throughput from Leader partitions only.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(taskite_job_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",action="completed"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

sum by (cluster) (rate(taskite_job_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",action="failed"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

taskite_stream_processor_record_count{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",state="pending"} and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

panels.title: Pending Records by Partition
panels.description: Current unprocessed record backlog for each Leader partition. This is a Gauge sampled at each scrape, not a counter or interval rate.

targets.expr: taskite_stream_processor_record_count{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",state=~"processed|committed"} and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

panels.title: Partition Record Counts
panels.description: Committed and processed record high-water counts for each Leader partition. These cumulative positions are exported as Gauges, not interval rates.

targets.expr: process_cpu_usage{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"}

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Process CPU utilization for each Broker in the selected Cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (broker, area) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"})
sum by (broker, area) (jvm_memory_committed_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"})
sum by (broker, area) (clamp_min(jvm_memory_max_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"}, 0))

panels.title: JVM Memory
panels.description: JVM memory used, committed, and maximum capacity by Broker and memory area.

targets.expr: max by (broker, path) (disk_total_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"}) - max by (broker, path) (disk_free_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"})
max by (broker, path) (disk_free_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker"})

panels.title: Disk Capacity
panels.description: Used and free filesystem capacity visible to each Broker process.

panels.title: Command & Record Processing - $cluster
panels.description: Broker record stream consumption, command queue depth, and command completion latency.

(sum by (cluster, broker, partition) (rate(taskite_stream_processor_records_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",action="written"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (cluster, broker, partition) (rate(taskite_stream_processor_records_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition",action="processed"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cluster, broker, partition) (rate(taskite_stream_partition_command_pending_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cluster, broker, partition) (rate(taskite_stream_partition_command_pending_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cluster, broker, partition, phase) (rate(taskite_stream_partition_command_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

sum by (cluster, job_type, action) (rate(taskite_job_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

sum by (cluster, action) (rate(taskite_incident_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3)))

taskite_pending_incidents{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, cluster, broker, partition) (rate(taskite_stream_processor_batch_commands_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, broker, partition) (max by (cluster, broker, partition) (taskite_pd_partition_role{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",broker=~"$broker",partition=~"$partition"} == 3))
